sprints.title: Independent evidence harvest
sprints.purpose: Research the domains that do not require a finished cross-system contract. Five persistent Opus owners work in parallel.
sprints.gate: Five verified evidence packets; no synthesis contracts promoted.

lanes.title: Client demand science
lanes.result: Client-intelligence and ProductSpec evidence packs joined to all 17 industries.
notes: Industry priors and first-principles question policy

lanes.title: Capability supply graph
lanes.result: Top-100 candidate shelf with top-10 dossiers, overlap graph and industry joins.
notes: User-provided SaaS/repository lists retained as a separate source lane

lanes.title: Experience science
lanes.result: Component taxonomy, preference-science report and shell/archetype option map.
notes: ISSO, SISOCRM, Bykonz and competitor shell comparisons

lanes.title: Host foundation
lanes.result: Data, identity/settings/navigation and connector evidence packs.
notes: Host absorption and donor chrome removal

lanes.title: Editor, runtime and learning
lanes.result: Private/OSS editor census, runtime profiles and production-learning model.
notes: Open Design and comparable editor census

sprints.title: Framework and contract synthesis
sprints.purpose: Use Sprint 1 evidence to design the three missing cross-domain systems and formalize the experience/runtime contracts.
sprints.gate: All 15 node contracts reconcile; solver dry-run returns no hidden dependency.

lanes.title: Repo-to-block framework
lanes.result: Source-shape protocol, normalization surgery map and three worked conversion traces.
notes: Consumes P03, P09, P10 and P14

lanes.title: Design harmonization
lanes.result: Token extraction/mapping contract and visual-coherence experiments.
notes: Produces semantic token and scoped bridge contracts

lanes.title: Shell and editing framework
lanes.result: Archetype/shell contract plus an upgrade-safe visual change model.

lanes.title: Deterministic composer
lanes.result: Compatibility schema, solver, UNDERDETERMINED protocol and synthetic fixtures.
notes: Measures glue budget and clarification needs

lanes.title: Runtime and learning contracts
lanes.result: Runtime profile, qualification, release, rollback and feedback contracts.

sprints.title: Convergence and pilot blueprint
sprints.purpose: Pressure-test the complete graph against one industry workflow and produce a build-ready, independently reviewed pilot packet.
sprints.gate: One chosen pilot, complete contracts, falsifiable evals and no unresolved critical edge.

lanes.title: Pilot demand and workflow
lanes.result: Industry choice, client workflow, archetype and acceptance fixtures.
notes: Keeps one generic dashboard as control only

lanes.title: Pilot supply pack
lanes.result: Exact service, block, components and visual bindings for the pilot.
notes: No substitute or padding when supply is weak

lanes.title: Pilot host pack
lanes.result: Data, identity, settings, connectors, runtime and rollback plan.

lanes.title: Pilot assembly and editor
lanes.result: Deterministic AssemblyPlan, bounded change model and complete eval sequence.
notes: Compares custom build, direct generation and assembly
Measures tokens, repairs and glue size

lanes.title: Independent adversary
lanes.result: Cross-source verification, contradiction ledger and proceed/redesign/stop verdict.
notes: Attempts to falsify every promoted claim
Checks all 15 pages and source receipts

convergence.title: Sprint 1 evidence convergence
convergence.purpose: Turn five independent lane returns into one verified architectural handoff. Research owners supply evidence; the coordinator reconciles it; an independent verifier attacks it; Shaan decides consequential trade-offs.

inputs.contribution: Client evidence, industry priors, question policy and candidate ProductSpec.
Capability shelf, top-10 dossiers, overlap graph and industry joins.
Component taxonomy, preference experiments and shell/archetype options.
Data ownership, host identity/settings/navigation and connector constraints.
Editor operations, runtime/release profiles and learning evidence.

artifacts.purpose: Readable synthesis of shared findings, contradictions, unknowns and architectural implications.
Machine-readable candidate inputs, outputs, invariants and unresolved fields for every moving part.
Exact evidence and contract dependencies between Sprint 1 findings and Sprint 2 owners.
Resolved, provisional, contradictory, experiment-required, operator-required and deferred decisions.

verification: Coordinator verifies packet counts, source identities, hashes, evidence classes and links.
Claims are deduplicated and normalized without rewriting historical receipts.
Contradictions and missing evidence remain explicit; no majority-vote synthesis.
A fresh-context Opus verifier attempts to falsify promoted claims but owns no product decision.
Shaan reviews decisions that change product direction, scope or irreversible architecture.

sprint_2_edges.result: Formal P08 shell and P13 bounded-editor contracts
P12 deterministic composer and compatibility schema
Formal runtime, qualification, release, rollback and learning contracts

convergence.promotion_gate: All five lane callbacks exist, twelve part packets pass structural and claim verification, four convergence artifacts exist, contradictions are classified, and operator-required decisions are reviewed. Until then Sprint 2 remains blocked.

common_reads: The dedicated page and linked resources for every owned part
output_contract: source-register.jsonl — every commercial, OSS and local source
top-companies.jsonl and top-repos.jsonl — explicit denominators and top-10 dossiers
innovation-register.jsonl — wide ideas, scores and retained top 10
first-principles.md — irreducible problem, assumptions, contradictions and design
decision-ledger.json — decisions, confidence, falsifiers and dependencies
lane-state.json — counts, hashes, blockers, verification and callback
